statement.text: We build websites and dashboards that answer your customers at any hour — in Arabic, English, or both.

problem.title: Customers decide in minutes. Are you there when they do?
problem.titleRest: Are you there when they do?
problem.intro: Most small businesses don't lose customers to bad service. They lose them before the first conversation.

missed.title: The phone rings while you're busy
missed.text: A customer calls during the rush or after closing. Nobody answers, so they book with the next business on the list.

repeat.title: The same questions, all day long
repeat.text: Prices, opening hours, location, "do you have a table at 9?". Your team repeats answers instead of serving the customers in front of them.

lost.title: Requests lost in chats and notebooks
lost.text: Orders are spread across WhatsApp, calls and paper. One gets forgotten, and that customer doesn't come back.

problem.answer: A website that works for you solves all three, every day, without extra staff.

how.label: How we work
how.intro: No tech talk. You answer a few questions, we recommend the right product, and you see it grow until launch.

step1.title: Tell us about your business
step1.text: Answer a few short questions, or just message us on WhatsApp.

step2.title: Get an honest recommendation
step2.text: We tell you which product fits, with a clear price, and show you a working example close to your idea.

step3.title: Watch it being built
step3.text: You review the work as it grows, so the result is never a surprise.

step4.title: Launch, and we stay close
step4.text: We put it online, show you how to use it, and support you after launch.

value.label: What changes
value.title: What changes when your website works for you
value.titleRest: when your website works for you
value.intro: Your website stops being a brochure and starts doing the work: taking requests, answering questions and keeping everything in one place.

customers.title: Customers reach you at any hour
customers.text: They book, order or ask at 2 am without calling. You wake up to new requests, not missed chances.

dashboard.title: Your whole day on one screen
dashboard.text: Every booking and order appears the moment it happens, so you always know what today looks like.

languages.title: Every customer in their own language
languages.text: Arabic and English, with true right-to-left layout, so every customer feels the business speaks to them.

edit.title: Change it yourself, any time.
edit.text: Texts, photos, prices and opening hours are yours to edit from your phone, in Arabic and English. No developer, no waiting.

flow.title: Nothing to copy by hand
flow.text: A request on your site reaches your dashboard and your WhatsApp in seconds, and the customer gets an instant confirmation.

visuals.instant: Instant confirmation — the customer never waits for a call back.

deliver.label: What we build
deliver.title: Pick the product that fits your business
deliver.intro: Three kinds of products for three different needs. We tell you honestly which one you need, even when it's the smaller one.

website.title: Business website
website.text: A fast, polished website that shows who you are, what you offer and how to reach you. Best when customers mainly need to know you and contact you.
website.bestFor: Best for: a clear presence and easy contact.

system.title: Website with a dashboard
system.text: Customers book, order or send requests on your site, and you manage everything from a dashboard on your phone. Best when you want the website to do the work.
system.bestFor: Best for: bookings, orders and requests you manage daily.

saas.title: Custom system or SaaS
saas.text: Software built around how you really work, or a product you sell to many customers, each with their own account. Best when ready-made tools no longer fit.
saas.bestFor: Best for: workflows no ready-made tool fits.

guide.label: Not sure yet?
guide.title: Website, system or SaaS? Find out in 2 minutes
guide.text: Many owners ask for a website when they need a system, or the other way round. Answer a few simple questions and see which type fits your business.

demos.badge: Don't take our word for it
demos.title: Try it yourself, right now
demos.text: Open a real restaurant, clinic or real-estate website. Book a table or an appointment, then open its dashboard and watch your request arrive. No sign-up with us; everything stays in your browser.

principle.label: Our principle
principle.quoteLead: “You don't need more features. You need a website that brings customers.”
principle.quoteRest: We tell you honestly which product fits, even when it's the smaller one.

faq.label: Questions
faq.intro: Straight answers, before you spend a minute of your time.

price.a: It depends on what you need: a business website costs less than a system with a dashboard. Tell us about your project and you get a clear price before any work starts.

time.a: We agree on a timeline with you before we start, and you see progress while we build, so you always know where things stand.

update.q: I'm not technical. Can I update the site myself?
update.a: Yes. You change texts, photos, prices and opening hours from your dashboard, in Arabic and English, right from your phone. You can try it now in any demo.

phone.q: Will it work well on phones?
phone.a: Every page is designed for phones first, because that's where most of your customers will find you, often from social media and WhatsApp.

which.q: Do I need a website, a system or a SaaS?
which.a: Most owners aren't sure at first, and that's normal. Our free Software Guide explains the difference in plain words and suggests the right type.

after.a: We stay with you: we show you how to use everything, fix what needs fixing and help you grow the site when your business grows.

cta.title: Your next customer is looking for you right now
cta.titleRest: is looking for you right now.
